PAPERS.title: Performance evaluation of Plantower's PMSX003N: laboratory and field analysis
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5 and PM10 from three PMSX003N, three PMS5003T and three Alphasense OPC-N3 against FEM reference; laboratory size-bin response to monodisperse DOS aerosol
PAPERS.n: 5-month co-location at a Utah DEQ station, Dec 2025-Apr 2026, spanning dust events, winter inversions, freezing fog, mist, snow and rain; 9 sensors, 3 models

PAPERS.title: Exploring the variability in emissions for broadcast and pile prescribed burns using low-cost sensors
PAPERS.pm: Low-cost-sensor emission factors for CO and PM2.5, with filter-based EC/OC and speciated organics, resolved by modified combustion efficiency
PAPERS.n: 19 prescribed fires across Colorado and southeastern Georgia; multiple monitors per burn, high temporal resolution

PAPERS.title: Multisource observation-constrained tuning for air quality forecasting in a machine learning-enhanced NOAA Unified Forecast System
PAPERS.pm: Surface PM2.5 and O3 fields reconstructed from VIIRS AOD, TEMPO NO2 and EPA AirNow, used as initial conditions for 72 h UFS-AQM forecasts
PAPERS.n: Continental US; ConvLSTM-ResNet fusion (DeepAQM); 72 h horizon, independent evaluation period

PAPERS.title: Evaluation of smoke mass concentration within the PBL based on observations of fluorescence lidar with several discrete channels
PAPERS.pm: Smoke mass concentration retrieved from five-channel fluorescence lidar spectra, separating smoke from urban aerosol; detection threshold ~0.1 ug/m3
PAPERS.n: Moscow, 2023-2024; smoke detected in 59 of 67 measurement sessions April-October 2024; 12 episodes from southern Russian fires

PAPERS.title: A microfluidic multispectral diffraction platform for quantitative analysis of atmospheric black carbon aerosols
PAPERS.pm: Black carbon mass concentration from lensless multispectral (400-800 nm) diffraction fingerprints after microfluidic inertial separation and electrostatic capture
PAPERS.n: Enrichment efficiency 92%; calibration over 0.01-0.20 mg/m3, R2=0.98; BC discriminated from microplastics and pathogenic spores

PAPERS.title: Cumulative and real-time performance of consumer-grade electronic radon monitors in a Canadian single-family home over three months
PAPERS.pm: Radon activity concentration from 45 consumer monitors against an AlphaGuard PQ2000 and two alpha-track detectors; PM2.5, CO2, T and RH co-recorded
PAPERS.n: 98-day co-location, 15 models x 3 units, occupied home in Waterloo, Ontario; reference mean 99 Bq/m3 (range 62-141)

PAPERS.title: Explainable machine learning prediction of long-term variations in cloud condensation nuclei at a high mountain site in the North China Plain
PAPERS.pm: CCN number concentration reconstructed from particle number size distribution and chemistry; bulk activation ratio and hygroscopicity parameter
PAPERS.n: High mountain site, 2007-2025; XGBoost with SHAP attribution plus PMF source apportionment; PNSD carries 55.7-66.3% of predictive importance

PAPERS.title: Physics-informed machine learning for urban nitrogen dioxide forecasting in Palermo, Italy
PAPERS.pm: Hourly NO2 at ~11 m resolution: COPERT-Italy emission factors dispersed through the SIRANE street-network model, then fused with measurements in an ML stage
PAPERS.n: Viale Regione Siciliana corridor, 2020-2025; 44,752 hourly observation-model pairs; chain inverted to recover corridor traffic from observed NO2

PAPERS.title: Management of missing air pollution data within urban environments using machine learning regressions: a case study for Delhi, India
PAPERS.pm: Iterative reconstruction of missing daily PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2 and CO from the four most-correlated neighbouring stations; 35 candidate regressors per gap
PAPERS.n: Delhi, 45 stations 2014-2024 (only 4 stations in 2014); validated by artificial-gap experiments across pollutants, stations and years

PAPERS.title: Raman spectroscopy resolves nitrogen-driven metabolic acclimation to urban air pollution in Quercus ilex
PAPERS.pm: Leaf Raman band intensities (chlorophyll, carotenoid, flavonoid) as a non-destructive biomonitoring index along an NO2 and PM10 gradient
PAPERS.n: Mature Quercus ilex along a high/intermediate/low pollution gradient in Tuscany; cross-checked against destructive biochemistry and chlorophyll fluorescence

PAPERS.title: Molecular packing engineering enables a high performance ppb-level room-temperature NO2 sensor
PAPERS.pm: Gas-phase NO2 (not particulate): chemiresistive response of cyano-substituted distyrylbenzene films with tuned alkyl-chain length and molecular packing
PAPERS.n: Limit of detection 30 ppb at room temperature; humidity-enhanced response; flexible device wired into a wireless vehicle-exhaust monitoring demonstrator

PAPERS.title: No one is immune: neighborhood trends and disparities in air pollution exposure in the city of Chicago during summer 2023 wildfires
PAPERS.pm: Daily 24 h tract-level PM2.5 from hourly 500 m gridded estimates, split by wildfire-smoke and non-smoke days
PAPERS.n: 792 Chicago census tracts in nine regions, 1 May-31 July 2023, stratified by demographic, socio-economic and health profile

PAPERS.title: Exposure of children to multiple long-term air pollutants (PM2.5, BC, NO2) and noise at home and school in Accra, Ghana
PAPERS.pm: Annual mean PM2.5, NO2 and BC from land-use regression at geocoded home and school points, combined into a time-location-weighted total; Lday/Lnight/Lden noise alongside
PAPERS.n: Accra School Health and Environment Study: 1,034 children aged 8-12 from 90 schools (73% public); 919 with valid linked data

PAPERS.title: Wind shear structures and their association with the vertical distribution of PM2.5 in Taiyuan Basin
PAPERS.pm: Vertical PM2.5 profiles from aerosol lidar and UAV, against vertical wind shear regimes from wind profiler radar, microwave radiometer, radiosonde and WRF
PAPERS.n: Taiyuan Basin, complex terrain; unsupervised clustering into three VWS regimes; UAV profiles 0-500 m; episode case study 17 January 2024

PAPERS.title: Machine learning attribution of atmospheric black carbon in a coastal city: source variability and the sea-land breeze recirculation mechanism
PAPERS.pm: Online BC split into fossil-fuel and biomass-burning fractions by the Aethalometer model, then attributed to meteorology by random forest and trajectory analysis
PAPERS.n: Qingdao, full-year 2021 online BC; annual mean 1.78 +/- 1.29 ug/m3; fossil fuel 88.2% of mass, biomass burning rising to 19% in winter

PAPERS.title: Molecular characterization of nighttime new particle formation in a coastal urban environment: season-dependent roles of sulfuric acid and oxygenated organics
PAPERS.pm: Nocturnal H2SO4, its dimers and oxygenated organic molecules measured alongside nascent particle number, by nitrate- and Vocus-type mass spectrometry
PAPERS.n: Dalian, ~1.5 years of continuous measurement; OOM dimers correlate with nascent particles at mean Pearson r=0.55 in summer and warm autumn

PAPERS.title: Understanding unexpected ozone-health associations: are secondary oxidative pollutants key?
PAPERS.pm: Measured O3 as a proxy for an unmeasured oxidant field; argues low O3 can coincide with active oxidative chemistry producing toxic unmeasured secondary products
PAPERS.n: Perspective; no primary data. Targets the recurring finding that lower O3 associates with worse health in population studies

PAPERS.title: From percentiles to distributions: nationwide ZCTA-level modeling of indoor radon exposure across the contiguous United States, 2000-2021
PAPERS.pm: Within-area distributions of indoor radon concentration modelled at ZCTA level, rather than area means or medians
PAPERS.n: More than 6 million short-term radon measurements, contiguous US, 2000-2021; roughly half of ZCTAs have >=1 in 5 households above policy thresholds

PAPERS.title: What are the sources of unclassified organosulfates in the atmosphere?
PAPERS.pm: Molecular formulas of ambient particulate organosulfates, which contribute up to 30% of aerosol mass, mapped to known precursors and formation routes
PAPERS.n: 366 compiled ambient OS formulas; ~36% assignable to known mechanisms, 64% unclassified; multiphase transformation products explain a further 5%

PAPERS.title: Upward transport and segregation of ice-nucleating particles in deep convective clouds
PAPERS.pm: Immersion-mode INP concentration-temperature spectra from filter samples of convective inflow, outflow and cloud-particle residuals
PAPERS.n: HALO aircraft, CIRRUS-HL campaign, summer 2021, up to 14.5 km; offline INP analysis of inflow vs outflow

PAPERS.title: Interactive migration of heavy metals between dust and soil demonstrated by the coupling coordination analysis
PAPERS.pm: Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn, As and Pb in paired surface dust and soil, scored with Igeo and the Nemerow index and coupled across the two media
PAPERS.n: 52 paired dust and soil samples (104 total) at bus stops in Weiyang District, Xi'an; hand-to-mouth ingestion the dominant route, children above adults

PAPERS.title: Estimation of background PM2.5 concentrations in the Valencian Community applying clustering technique
PAPERS.pm: Regional background PM2.5 separated from local increment by clustering of monitoring-network records
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - Elsevier deposit carries no abstract and the record is not yet in PubMed, Europe PMC or Semantic Scholar; network size and method detail not retrievable

PAPERS.title: Characteristics, sources, and health risks of PM2.5-bound potentially toxic elements (PTEs) in Lagos, Nigeria
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5-bound potentially toxic elements with source apportionment and health-risk characterisation
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract deposited; sampling duration, element list and risk estimates not retrievable on this run. Author list includes P.A. Solomon and P.K. Hopke

PAPERS.title: Exposure to outdoor ultrafine particle number concentrations and incidence of childhood cancer: a population-based cohort study
PAPERS.pm: High-resolution outdoor UFP number concentration and mean UFP size at six-digit residential postal codes from annual tax records; prenatal and postnatal windows
PAPERS.n: 965,000+ children born in Montreal or Toronto 1999-2020, mean follow-up 9.1 y to age 14; 1,625 incident cancers

PAPERS.title: Effect of long-term exposure to PM2.5 and its chemical components on frailty incidence in middle-aged and older adults in China: a prospective cohort study
PAPERS.journal: Sichuan Da Xue Xue Bao Yi Xue Ban
PAPERS.pm: One-year mean PM2.5 and its black carbon, organic matter, sulfate, nitrate and ammonium fractions from the Tracking Air Pollution dataset, per IQR
PAPERS.n: CHARLS 2011-2020, n=9,603; frailty index outcome, time-dependent Cox models

PAPERS.title: Association between ozone and emergency department visits in people with disabilities in South Korea: a nationwide case-crossover study
PAPERS.pm: Daily 8 h maximum ozone, 3-day moving average (lag 0-2), per IQR (~22 ppb), adjusted for daily mean temperature; no particulate metric
PAPERS.n: Korean National Health Insurance Service, 2015-19 and 2022-23; 3,484,877 ED visits, stratified by disability status and type

PAPERS.title: Timing matters: component-specific PM2.5 exposure windows and oocyte development in assisted reproduction
PAPERS.pm: Individual PM2.5 and its sulfate, nitrate, ammonium, organic matter and black carbon fractions over recent (0-3 mo), distal (4-12 mo) and cumulative (0-12 mo) windows
PAPERS.n: 51,122 ART cycles; negative binomial regression on total, mature and normally fertilised oocyte counts, DLNM for windows, mixture models for joint effects

PAPERS.title: The impact of PM2.5 component exposure during early pregnancy on congenital heart disease: evidence from Guangdong, China
PAPERS.pm: Satellite-derived PM2.5 components (OM, sulfate, nitrate, ammonium, BC) by week of early pregnancy; quantile g-computation for mixture weights
PAPERS.n: 2,601,300 live births and stillbirths, Guangdong 2014-2017; effect sizes peak in pregnancy week 1

PAPERS.title: Occupational wood dust exposure and lung function impairment: a systematic review and meta-analysis
PAPERS.pm: Occupational wood dust exposure, categorical (exposed vs unexposed); no quantitative dust concentration pooled
PAPERS.n: 55 studies in qualitative synthesis; 16, 14 and 9 studies pooled for FEV1, FVC and PEFR percent predicted; I2 > 95%

PAPERS.title: Clean heating renovation differentially reduces nitro-PAH and nitrated phenol exposure: implications from real-world personal monitoring and NF-kB-based toxicity
PAPERS.pm: Size-resolved personal exposure to particulate nitrated phenols and nitro-PAHs among users of clean coal, raw coal chunk and biomass
PAPERS.n: Rural solid-fuel households by fuel group; A549 cytotoxicity and NF-kB reporter assays on representative compounds; molecular docking for mechanism

PAPERS.title: Wooden-framed all-cellulose HEPA nanofilter for sustainable air purification
PAPERS.pm: PM0.3 removal efficiency and pressure drop of a fog-sprayed, freeze-dried bacterial-cellulose nanofibre layer on a cellulose-microfibre substrate
PAPERS.n: Optimum at 2 g/m2 BCNF grammage: 99.998% PM0.3 removal at 150 Pa, inside the EN 1822 H13-H14 band; efficiency peaks at high RH under cyclic humidity

PAPERS.title: Air pollution and heat impacts on respiratory morbidity and mortality outcomes in Africa: a systematic review towards a meta-analysis
PAPERS.pm: Reported indoor and ambient PM2.5 and nitrogen oxides across included case-control studies; no pooled exposure-response
PAPERS.n: 13 case-control studies from 10 African countries, published 2015-2025; indoor PM2.5 96-177 ug/m3 in biomass homes, ambient PM2.5 to 259 ug/m3

PAPERS.title: Epidemic thunderstorm asthma in China: a systematic review of an Artemisia-associated phenotype
PAPERS.pm: Airborne pollen as the causal particle; most Chinese reports identify sensitisation only to genus-level Artemisia, without species-level aerobiological confirmation
PAPERS.n: 54 primary studies (43 international, 11 Chinese: Yulin, Hohhot, Chongqing, Lanzhou, Shenzhen) from 436 records; no meta-analysis, GRADE certainty low to very low

PAPERS.title: Adverse effects of airborne heavy metals on human skin cells: insights from sebum analysis of indoor and outdoor workers
PAPERS.pm: 24 metals quantified by ICP-MS in sebum, then reconstituted as sebum-mimicking metal mixtures at the measured indoor and outdoor profiles
PAPERS.n: Sebum from 62 indoor and 40 outdoor workers in Shanghai; keratinocytes, sebocytes and ex vivo human scalp skin

PAPERS.title: Contrasting cellular reactive oxygen species modulation by alpha-dicarbonyl aqueous reaction products via interactions with redox-active particulate matter
PAPERS.pm: Aqueous reaction products of glyoxal or methylglyoxal with ammonium sulfate or glycine, characterised by HRMS, then co-exposed with redox-active PM surrogates
PAPERS.n: A549 cells; products tested alone and with 1,4-naphthoquinone, Cu2+ or both; acellular assays run in parallel

PAPERS.title: Interfacial chemistry and multiscale aging of atmospheric black carbon: from surface reactions to coating, morphology, and model parameterization
PAPERS.pm: Black carbon particle state - surface reactivity, coating thickness, morphology and aging timescale - as the link between emission and optical, cloud and toxicological behaviour
PAPERS.n: Review; integrates laboratory interfacial chemistry, field observation and model parameterisation. No primary data

PAPERS.title: Neural exposome burden stratifies cognitive trajectories in a subacute-to-chronic mild TBI outpatient cohort: an exploratory dimension-reduction study
PAPERS.pm: Residential PM2.5 as one of 13 exposome variables entering a principal-component burden score, alongside education, area deprivation and adverse childhood events
PAPERS.n: 44 adults with mild TBI (GCS 13-15, 50% female); residualised 6-month MoCA dichotomised; PC1 explains 16.0% of variance

PAPERS.title: Significant near-term inequity under China's 2035 NDC due to a time lag in mitigation effects across regions
PAPERS.pm: Air-quality health co-benefits monetised alongside climate benefits under the 2035 NDC pathway, resolved by region and by decade
PAPERS.n: Integrated modelling framework, 2025-2060; net benefit +1500.5 bn USD, long-run climate 3924.3 bn USD and health co-benefits 1659.5 bn USD
